scope.coverage: At the exact 52-character raw diagnostic ceiling, active repair dispatches scripted ACP and reaches the injected receipt-bound compile-valid validator. A 53-character diagnostic is refused before dispatch or validation; the failed run is retained as RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, with unchanged accepted source/head/node count, no pending attempt, and an empty retained corpus. The same invocation includes existing exact/one-over retained-input byte, input-count, and argument-count boundaries.
